description: I am an engineering student passionate about exploring emerging technologies, AI, and innovation. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, I aim to showcase my creativity and technical skills by developing an interactive astronaut-training game. My goal is to help curious minds discover how astronauts are trained, understand their challenges, and explore fascinating facts about astronaut life and space missions through an engaging learning experience.
summary:
ASTRA: The Last 30 Days is an interactive lunar survival and astronaut training game that allows players to experience the challenges of managing a 30-day Moon mission.

Players take responsibility for a crew of four astronauts, manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food and power, respond to unexpected emergencies, and make critical decisions to keep their crew safe.

Inspired by real lunar exploration concepts and NASA space research, ASTRA combines interactive gameplay, resource management and educational discoveries to make space exploration more engaging and accessible, especially for young learners curious about astronaut life.
details:
The Idea

ASTRA – The Last 30 Days is a browser-based lunar survival simulation designed to introduce players to the challenges of astronaut life and long-duration Moon missions.

The game places players in charge of a lunar crew consisting of four astronauts. Their mission is to survive 30 days on the Moon while maintaining the habitat, monitoring resources and making important decisions.

How It Works

The experience begins with astronaut and rocket selection, followed by mission preparation and landing.

Throughout the 30-day mission, players must:

  • Monitor oxygen, water, food and electrical power.
  • Maintain crew health and habitat safety.
  • Make decisions during daily mission scenarios.
  • Handle unexpected emergencies.
  • Discover educational facts about space exploration.
  • Complete training milestones and unlock achievement badges.

Player decisions and resource management influence mission progress and survival outcomes.

What Makes ASTRA Different?

ASTRA combines an educational experience with an interactive survival game. Instead of simply reading about space exploration, players actively experience the importance of planning, teamwork, decision-making and resource conservation.

The game aims to encourage curiosity about lunar exploration and help younger audiences understand some of the challenges involved in establishing a sustainable human presence on the Moon.

Expected Impact

ASTRA aims to make space science more approachable and enjoyable through game-based learning. It encourages curiosity, critical thinking and awareness of the technology and planning required for future lunar missions.
